name: registry_contract
invariant: INV-8 / INV-20 — GET /api/v1/registry/{uuid}/manifest?version=N is the pinned, version-addressed read a client adopts from; a host that advertises no /cluster page serves no registry
notes: Pins the versioned-read contract the adoption flow deserializes when a host advertises 'registry_reads' in /cluster features[]: 'current_version' is recorded into dataset_sync_state.published_version (the immutable version an adopted copy is stamped against, INV-8), and 'overall_hash'/'row_hash'/'files' drive the install + short-circuit exactly as the live /datasets manifest does. The harness also asserts host_without_cluster_advertises('registry_reads') == false — the default-deny gate (INV-20) means today's website, which serves no /cluster page, falls back to the live /api/v1/datasets/{uuid}/manifest|snapshot route unchanged; only the read route and published_version differ, never the install location or provenance. The cross-host parity check activates when the website grows the versioned registry route (phase 3 website-side / 7a).
